[SWS_TS_00202]
⌈
ara::tsync::SynchronizedTimeBaseConsumer::Ge-
tRateDeviation
shall return the calculated rate deviation of its TBR against the
time source it is synchronized to. In case there is no rate deviation calculated yet, the
initial rate deviation of 0.0 shall be returned.
⌋
(RS_TS_00018)
Note:
For more information of how rate deviation is calculated see: 7.3.6 Time Correc-
tion.
7.1.1.3 Clock Time Value
Reading the clock's time value is very likely the most commonly performed operation
by the applications interacting with TS.
